title: 登记 Skin Standalone 为 F1 受限准备方向
objective: 以治理记录登记项目所有者已批准的 Skin Standalone 提前建设授权：mc-plan-skin 作为 F1 中受限的 Standalone 准备方向，允许且仅允许不依赖 Core、Community、Keycloak 的工程骨架与最小纵向链路；保持 mc-plan-core 为 F1 全局主要项目，不宣布 F3 开始，不绕过 Core、Community 的 Official 集成门槛。
in_scope: 新增 ADR-0009：提前建设的范围、原因、限制和退出条件
direction.json 登记受限准备项目并扩展 direction.v1 schema 的可选字段
更新路线图、组合状态、Foundation 状态页与协调模型说明
记录与活动 MCP-F1-CORE-001 工作流无锁交集的治理验证证据
out_of_scope: 公共 OpenAPI、JSON Schema、事件、OAuth scope 或 SDK 修改
正式 AI 提供商、3D 预览库、Official 登录或额度集成选择
远程仓库、推送、密钥、生产域名和真实生产值
contract_impact: none; registration-only governance change; no public contract surface is added or modified
acceptance_evidence: ADR-0009 records the owner authorization, allowed scope, exclusions, and re-evaluation conditions
direction.json registers mc-plan-skin as a restricted F1 preparation project with a machine-readable optional schema field while mc-plan-core remains the F1 primary repository
roadmap, portfolio, and Foundation status reflect the restricted preparation direction without announcing F3 or bypassing Official integration gates
Coordination Start and Continue validation pass with no lock overlap against the active MCP-F1-CORE-001 workflow
Workspace validation and coordination regression tests pass on the completed branch

direction_exception.authorized_by: MC Plan project owner via explicit 2026-10-01 Skin Standalone early development authorization
direction_exception.reason: Register the owner-approved restricted Skin Standalone preparation direction in Foundation governance while mc-plan-core remains the F1 primary project.
